sell_axis_matrix.time: 09:00~09:28 open tick regime. parent buy는 09:00~09:07까지만 진입하지만 sell은 09:30 이전 exit rule이 핵심이다.

mutation_contract.expected_effect: Find whether sell-only changes can reduce MDD/give-back without reducing entries.
mutation_contract.risk_note: Every sell trigger may cut winners early; result must be interpreted through profit/MDD/trade count/hold time.

next_recommendation: Evaluate sell-only axes one at a time; do not combine with buy-side reject filters until standalone sell effect is known.

root_cause.primary: 직전 buy-side reject 연구는 MDD를 낮추는 축을 찾았지만 거래수와 profit을 줄였다. 이번 연구는 동일한 진입 coverage를 유지하고 sell 조건만 변경해 give-back, hard stop, hold-time loss, orderflow/MA breakdown을 분리 검증한다.
